account: Today has seemed mostly routine. I made my market visit, went home for lunch, reviewed town accounts, and attended tea at the neighbour's east-dock cottage. The treasury held 128 emeralds, which I left untouched; the secretary reported no outstanding bills or confirmed deliveries. The baker said the stall was well stocked and reported eight emeralds in sales. Freight has repeatedly asked about delivery assignments and offered ferry crossings. That seems consistent with seeking work for the warehouse and ferry; I have no evidence of another purpose. I crossed by the bridge. The builder called earlier, but I could not make out what he said. The secretary confirmed his repair-quote appointment for 16:30, and he is now waiting near the office with a lantern. I do not yet know which repairs he proposes or their cost. The neighbour reported no confirmed dock news and no cottage problems needing attention. Several townsfolk have been travelling together, but I have seen nothing establishing any unusual business. It is now 16:26, and I have returned to town hall in time to meet the builder. Overall, I have not observed a clear emergency or unusual scheme; the main unresolved town business is the builder's proposed repairs.
